live.claim: The council is a physical, findable part of Boltborough with an explicit unlock.
live.proof: The open-ground golden gear platform, Arbiter-0 and four colored terminals were visible in the world. Its action said free permanent gear arguments. The route was corrected from inherited 4/2 state to exactly REPORTS HEARD: 2 and REQUIRED: 2, and the world map displayed FREE GEAR COUNCIL.

live.claim: Four named robots offer legible, unusual equipment manipulations without pressure mechanics.
live.proof: The live modal named Dock-3 Factory Wiring, Nib-7 Quiet Bypass, Chime-2 Heckler Overclock and Lux-11 Contradiction Harness, stated each consequence, and explicitly ruled out bolts, consumables, timers and reward penalties.

live.claim: Applying an argument changes executable item behavior at zero cost.
live.proof: Heckler Overclock changed Springpan Supreme from base power 8 to effective power 10. Inventory showed BONK radius and the squeak drawback both WIRED TWICE; the visible bolt count remained 20.

live.claim: The selected argument is durable through an ordinary save reload.
live.proof: After returning to the title and continuing the saved world, Springpan Supreme still showed Heckler Overclock, effective power 10, base power 8 and both doubled wiring labels.

limitations: Repeated screenshots and bounded interaction prove visible states; no sub-frame timing is inferred.
Heckler Overclock was exercised live; Factory Wiring, Quiet Bypass, Contradiction Harness, locked-state progression and old-save normalization are covered structurally and deterministically.
